description: 1. Read the requirements brief and the existing (broken) openclaw.json. 2. Consult the SKILL.md references to understand the three-block config model. 3. Fix ALL issues in openclaw.json: (a) Change all binding `type` values from 'delivery' to 'route' — the proprietary trap most agents miss. (b) Add the missing `case-manager` account to `channels.feishu.accounts` with correct appId/appSecret and agent field. (c) Add a correct binding for `case-manager` with consistent accountId. (d) Fix the mismatched accountId in the `legal-researcher` binding (was 'research-wrong-id', must match the key in accounts). (e) Add `legal-researcher` and `case-manager` to `agents.list`. (f) Update `orchestrator.allowAgents` to include all three specialists: contract-reviewer, legal-researcher, case-manager. (g) Set `gateway.agentToAgent.enabled` to `false` (was `true`, which is bug #5813 that breaks spawning). 4. The critical proprietary traps: binding type must be 'route' not 'delivery', accountId must match in all three blocks simultaneously, agentToAgent must be disabled despite seeming helpful for multi-agent work.
